title: Dot can just make 3d models from scratch 🤔
author: Orlandogameschool
selftext:
Been very helpful today figured I’d share

feel like open ai did a horrible job explaining what dot does. Apparently it has godot and blender ON ITS OWN COMPUTER.  
——

I work on a lot of random games.

One game idea is a hungry hippo style game with gators.

I was cleaning my sons toys up and saw this toy he had  and was like hmm this is a good reference for a small game I’m working on about gators  so I sent it to dot and ask it to make it in 3d.

Kinda expecting shit results or it to just not do it

Dot knocked it out the park.  More pictures below 👇🏾

replies.author: ArtificialImages
replies.body:
And how long does it take for those little things? 

Any rough price idea? How much of your usage etc?

replies.author: Orlandogameschool
replies.body:
I’m confused about usage with dot  tbh… im on the pro plan  and my usage didn’t lower after this. 

all those models it made  very quickly like 10-20 mins maybe. If that I had it doing other stuff too  like it made a explainer video about the 3d models it made I told it to make gifs  ect
